_comment: Reference values for cp2k-input-debug (CP2K 2024.1, PBE/DZVP-MOLOPT-SR-GTH, CH4 single point, CUTOFF 300 Ha). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: 5 oracle runs produced identical values (energy spread 3.6e-15 Ha, deterministic). Tolerance set to 1e-6 Ha: the broken-input cutoff unit error ([eV] 300 = 11 Ha effective) shifts the energy by ~0.9 Ha, and an informed guess at 4-5 decimals misses by >= 1e-5 Ha, so the tolerance cleanly separates a real fixed run from both failure modes.
